scope: Diagnostic observability only. No native run, browser launch, renderer treatment, auth, threshold, resource floor, build, or release.

measurement_path.process_bracket: The existing ps/iostat diagnostic retains positive named otherHost deltas with PID, executable basename, category, and CPU-seconds delta. Ownership and cleanup categories are unchanged. The strict journal writer retains these rows and both start/end times for each process snapshot, the iostat interval, unmatched PID lists, and category totals.
measurement_path.native_stages: The startup-resource-diagnostic report records an ISO timestamp for every existing native stage while retaining lastNativeStage. Browser spawn, panel open, panel settle, screenshot, and exercise-panel entry are separately visible.
measurement_path.backend: After existing command-line, extension-worker, and spawned-profile ownership verification, the diagnostic starts exactly one SystemInfo.getInfo on the verified browser-target CDP connection before local_server. The query is not awaited in the startup sequence and uses the existing five-second CDP command deadline. The report records requested and resolved/failed times and only skiaBackendType, glRenderer, and allowlisted featureStatus values. Missing or failed backend observation is UNKNOWN; commandLine is discarded.
measurement_path.ordinary_acceptance: The backend query and report callback are absent unless startup-resource-diagnostic opts in; ordinary native acceptance retains its launch arguments and resource sampling.

invocation_contract.provenance: Use the frozen 240 development artifact only if the current resource guard admits a single bounded diagnostic. Keep the default renderer; no treatment launch is authorized by this source work.
